_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Inventory Adjustment Report
summary: Provides a detailed description of all adjustments made to Contractor-managed, Government-owned spare parts inventory, documenting the format, content, and intended use of the deliverable data.
use_relationship:
The Inventory Adjustment Report provides a detailed description of all adjustments made to Contractor-managed, Government-owned spare parts inventory.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the contract
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: For each adjustment request, the Inventory Adjustment Report shall include:

children.title: Current authorized allowance or stock level
Recommended new stock level including the time frame being supported
Impact on the mission if this data is not acquired (be specific)
Delivery and completion of the efforts
children.content: Delivery and completion of the efforts described in the Inventory Adjustment Report are imperative to maintaining appropriate and on-going custodial and reporting responsibilities for the management of Contractor-managed, Government-owned materiel support in support of the TACAMO mission.
